name: Sarvam AI
description: Sarvam AI is an Indian artificial intelligence startup developing a full-stack generative AI platform, sovereign AI systems, and large language models tailored to India's linguistic diversity and cultural contexts.
problem_they_solve: Addresses gaps in multilingual support and contextual understanding in existing AI models by delivering sovereign, full-stack AI capabilities and models built for Indian languages, accents, and region-specific use cases.

recent_changes.title: Announced approximately $41 million combined seed and Series A funding round led by Lightspeed Venture Partners
Raised $234 million in the first close of Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation
Introduced Sarvam Vision and Bulbul V3 products for multilingual visual understanding and text-to-speech
